def rd(self, signal):
    name = self.top_level.top_name + "." + self.top_level.dut_name + "." + self.namespace.get_name(signal)
    self.ipc.send(MessageRead(name))
    reply = self.ipc.recv()
    assert(isinstance(reply, MessageReadReply))
    # Handle negative numbers
    value = reply.value
    if value < 0:
        value = -value  # Convert to positive if negative
    # Cleanup LSBs (if needed)
    return value
